cefr_descriptor_refs: CEFR A1/A2 reading for orientation candidate

knowledge_tags.label: 从简短留言中寻找能提供帮助的人

items.prompt: Read the three messages on a school welcome board. For questions 1–3, choose Nina, Ben or Omar.

stimulus.Nina: I spend my lunch break in the library. I know where students can borrow storybooks. Come and find me if you need a book.
stimulus.Ben: I enjoy drawing. The art room is beside the music room. I can show you the way after class.
stimulus.Omar: On Wednesdays, I help in the school garden. New students can join me to plant flowers.

questions.text: You want to borrow a storybook. Who can help you?
You want to find a place to draw after class. Who should you ask?
You want to help grow flowers. Who can you join?

evidence_for_answer.Q1: Nina knows how to borrow storybooks from the library.
evidence_for_answer.Q2: Ben knows the art room and offers to show the way.
evidence_for_answer.Q3: Omar invites new students to plant flowers in the garden.

distractor_rationales.Q1: Ben discusses drawing; Omar discusses gardening.
distractor_rationales.Q2: Nina discusses library books; Omar discusses gardening.
distractor_rationales.Q3: Nina discusses library books; Ben discusses drawing.

items.explanation: 逐题指出留言中的支持信息；若学生选错，区分是否混淆活动地点、人物与需求，不从一次错误推断稳定能力缺陷。
items.support_allowed: 诊断时无词汇提示；练习时可提供词义卡，但另存作答条件

items.target_behaviour: 理解校园真实短消息的主要目的和关键安排

knowledge_tags.label: 识别短通知与同伴消息中的行动要求

items.prompt: Read each short message. Choose A, B or C for the best answer.

questions.stimulus: New students: Please leave a short note about one thing you enjoy on the welcome board before Friday. We will use the notes to make small activity groups.
questions.text: Why should new students write a note?

options.A: To help the school make activity groups
options.B: To ask for a different school timetable
options.C: To choose the food for Friday

questions.stimulus: Hi Jo, I will wait outside the library after school. The music room is closed today, so let’s practise in Room 6 instead. —Maya

evidence_for_answer.Q1: The note is used to make small activity groups.
evidence_for_answer.Q2: Maya says she will wait outside the library before they practise elsewhere.

Q1.B: The notice says nothing about timetables.
Q1.C: Friday is a deadline, not a food event.

Q2.C: Room 6 is where they will practise later, not where they meet first.

items.explanation: 先定位任务目的或时间顺序，再逐项比较选项；错选 Q2-C 时记录“把最终地点误作初次会合地点”为候选错因，另用新情境复测。
items.support_allowed: 诊断时无提示；练习时可提供关键词帮助并单独记录条件

items.target_behaviour: 向新同学写一条能达成认识和邀约目的的简短消息

knowledge_tags.label: 介绍自己并邀请新同学参加活动

items.prompt: A new classmate, Sam, wants to meet someone after school. Write Sam a message of at least 25 words. Say who you are and which class you are in, tell Sam one activity you enjoy, invite Sam to join you, and say where to meet.

analytic_rubric.scoring_note: 四维各0—3分，仅作内部草评；缺答、设备问题和未提交分开记录，不换算剑桥分数。

content.1: 只提供少量任务要求的信息
content.2: 大部分要求的信息已提供，仍缺少一项关键内容
content.3: 身份、班级、活动、邀请和地点均可找到

communicative_achievement.0: 收信人无法判断写信目的
communicative_achievement.1: 大致知道目的，但难以据此回应
communicative_achievement.2: 能理解邀请，个别细节不清
communicative_achievement.3: 能明确理解活动和见面安排并作出回应

organisation.3: 信息顺序清楚并有恰当的基本衔接

language.0: 语言不足以传达任务意图
language.1: 简单表达中有多处影响理解的问题
language.2: 能传达主要意思，存在不妨碍理解的错误
language.3: 简单词句使用较恰当，意思清楚

items.explanation: 根据原文引用已满足与缺失的信息，给出一个优先修改点和一项可迁移的新情境练习；Agent 按教师预授权量规给出有证据的评分；通过质量门后服务端自动批准，异常交教师复核。
items.support_allowed: 诊断时不提供整句模板；练习时可提供关键词表并单独记录
